experiment_data.hypothesis: 9-class DAPT maintains strong OOD generalization even at 25% training data (n=50-125), outperforming vanilla baseline at 100% data (n=350), demonstrating high sample efficiency of persuasion-grounded representations.

spec.note: Train set is 350 (not 500). Subset sizes: {50, 125, 250, 350}. 4 x 9class + 2 x vanilla = 6 conditions. Single seed=42.
